fit_card: Scored this gorgeous Y2K Baby Tee with the cutest butterfly print on Depop for only $18, and it's 100% staying in my closet. I’m obsessed with styling it for an effortless Y2K street vibe with baggy dark-wash denim and chunky sneakers. Such a dreamy find for leaning into that nostalgic cottagecore energy!

Just scored this vintage cropped light wash denim jacket on Poshmark for only $42 and I'm lowkey obsessed! It’s giving the ultimate double-denim moment over baggy jeans and fresh white sneakers. Can't wait to layer it over a black hoodie and combat boots for that effortless streetwear edge.

Scored these chunky white platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am obsessed! They are giving the ultimate Y2K off-duty model vibe with my baggy jeans and cropped hoodie. Can't wait to style them with wide-leg trousers for a cool streetwear prep look, too.

Scored this cute Y2K butterfly print baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I'm obsessed. I can't wait to lean into the nostalgic vibe by pairing it with baggy dark wash jeans and chunky sneakers for an easy streetwear look. It’s also going to look so good toughened up with wide-leg trousers and combat boots!

Scored these khaki low-rise cargo pants on Poshmark for just $27 and I am officially living my 2000s streetwear dreams. I'm styling them today with a cropped zip hoodie and chunky sneakers for the ultimate off-duty millennium edge. Such an easy win for the wardrobe!
